Description
: Discover the natural allure of raw minerals with this 3-piece set featuring striking Amethyst, vibrant Green Fluorite, and rich Lepidolite stones. Each stone boasts a distinct color and texture, inviting collectors and enthusiasts alike to appreciate their unique beauty. The Amethyst displays classic purple crystal formations, while the Green Fluorite offers translucent green hues. The Lepidolite piece is easily recognized by its lilac-tinted purple and layered appearance. These stones are ideal for mineral collectors, educational displays, or as thoughtful gifts for those exploring the world of geology. With their rough-hewn surfaces and natural shapes, they provide a tactile and visually appealing addition to any display. The included clear plastic storage box ensures easy organization and display. Overall, these stones are in visible used condition, each displaying the variations and natural imperfections typical of unpolished minerals, making every piece distinct. Stones measure approximately 2-3 inches each. Ruler and container shown for size reference only; no additional items are included
